entities.summary: Jadwiga Maria Rutkowska was a former Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1953–1964, a bronze medalist of the Olympic Games Tokyo 1964, a bronze medalist of the European Championship 1955), ten-time Polish Champion.
